findings.finding: Existing build_distill_cache and validator are W18-specific: coefficient sum0.8125, four historical families, two-epoch student convention, recurrent legacy checkpoint schema. They cannot represent normalized heterogeneous control/candidate pools or qualify TCN/GALAM unchanged.

findings.finding: Sequences.__getitem__ divides legacy scaled teacher sum by len(teachers). Literal unit-sum mixture weights would shrink the target by teacher count.
findings.required_resolution: Use direct preweighted cache targets with coefficient sum1; no extra mean/division.
findings.resolution_status: The direct preweighted two-column cache avoids the legacy division by teacher count.

findings.finding: sequence_predict rejects retained epochs with fitting membership, and default fitting exports include hint columns. GALAM retained epoch cannot be relabeled as a legacy checkpoint.

findings.resolution_status: The feature-only retained-epoch exporter reuses native epoch admission and original saved normalization, pins the exact g2 checkpoint and imports the original source-r9 model modules.

receiving_checks: Pin exact source/config/runtime/data/split/checkpoint/prediction files before profiles or fits.
Measure finite updates, peak memory, CPU/RAM/disk and OOM state with one owned device; preserve fixed batch/chunk/epoch choices.
LSTM/TCN prefix invariance, state reset and chunk-carry checks must exercise the actual model path.
Compare same-seed student initial-state, sampler order, normalization and update counts; same integer seed alone is not the complete evidence.
Never place valid rows/labels into learned ancestry or use valid to fit mixture coefficients.
Score blends in raw FP32 before official clipping with all1873 sequences/3528273 selected rows, and preserve failed/partial rows explicitly.
interpretation_limits: All official-valid evidence is exposed development evidence.
Two matched student seeds do not establish significance or teacher-training variance.
Teacher outputs on fitting data are in-sample distillation targets, not OOF estimates.
An improved teacher pool does not establish improved student transfer or a public-score gain.

scored_only_probe_source_review.row_order: Original Boolean [batch,time] extraction is batch-major then time-major, matching consecutive per-group offset ranges reconstructed by the adapter.

scored_only_probe_source_review.source_identity: The adapter pins prediction, receipt, plan, terminal result, checkpoint and epoch index; joins the g2 role and human epoch3/native epoch2; verifies original source/data digests and exact fitting/evaluation membership.

scored_only_probe_source_review.zero_placeholders: Zeros exist only in temporary per-sequence arrays outside the independently reconstructed scoring mask. Pointwise mixtures and the official masked metric cannot depend on those positions.
